correctness.rationale: Proof reconstructs exact hypotheses (finite projective planes q>=2), total four-variable budget and binary sort/incidence signature. An enhanced triple-type back-and-forth extension lemma for all q>=3 is proved by an exhaustive geometric case analysis of three points or two points plus a line (and dual cases). Every needed spare point/line count is positive at q>=3; the lower three-variable game works at q=2 as well. The explicit four-name sentence (including unary point/line guards in one-sorted syntax) is true exactly for q>=3 because it demands a fourth line through a point, using shadowing of the point name. Independent finite arithmetic checks in verify.py verify small cases including GF(4); these are corroboration only. No claims at k>4 or with counting.

value.rationale: Natural complete, sharp classification of the fixed-variable theories of all finite projective planes through width four, including arbitrary non-Desarguesian planes. It identifies a genuine threshold: no FO^3 sentence sees even the Fano exception, while one FO^4 sentence separates that exception and all orders >=3 collapse, despite differing cardinalities. The uniform enhanced-type extension lemma explains this stability structurally, not just through finite computation; it complements the fixed-order counting and sorted modal logics found in the foundational literature.
